'''Zokar''' was an employee of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] who worked in the [[Czerka Sentient Resources Department]] as the Security Commander during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Meet" />

During his fifteen year employment, he has protected some of Czerka's most sensitive and advanced facilities, and served on security details for four different Special Executives – including [[Rasmus Blys]].<ref name="Meet" />

Zokar was proficient with a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket-launcher]] and [[CryoBan grenade/Legends|cryo-grenades]]. He died while defending [[CZ-198]] from [[Seizure of CZ-198|intruders]] in [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="Flashpoint" />

==Personality and traits==
Outside of his security duties, Zokar was studying the art of of cuisine, practicing in [[CZ-198]]’s central kitchen.<ref name="Meet" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chief Zokar first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]] as one of the bosses in "Czerka Corporate Labs" flashpoint added in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|first digital expansion]] of the game. To complete the flashpoint, Zokar must be killed.<ref name="Flashpoint" />
